mechanism_narrative: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT stop falling and turn upward, weekday trip chaining and downtown footfall will recover, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the last four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days despite a week-on-week increase in both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT for at least two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated above its current level, people substitute home-based activity for discretionary shopping trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains at or above +8 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to decline within 14 days after RESIDENTIAL remains at or above +8 for two straight weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: A recovery in GROCERY_PHARM alongside a stabilization in PARKS indicates broader out-of-home circulation, which precedes a rebound in RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by at least 5 points from one week to the next while GROCERY_PHARM is nonnegative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not improve over the following 28 days after PARKS jumps by 5 points and GROCERY_PHARM is not negative.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT drops sharply below its recent range, access costs to shopping districts rise and discretionary retail mobility weakens over the next week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -33 after being above -32 the prior week
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 7 days after TRANSIT crosses from above -32 to below -33.

mechanism_narrative: A broad late-year shopping season effect lifts retail visits when GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC move together from one week to the next, producing higher RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC is not higher over the next 28 days when GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC both rise together for at least two weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in PARKS signals reduced leisure outing intensity, which spills into weaker discretionary shopping traffic and lower RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -5 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall within 14 days after PARKS stays below -5 for two straight weekly means.

mechanism_narrative: When WORKPLACES remain depressed but RESIDENTIAL continues to rise, commuting-based shopping trips are displaced and RETAIL_REC declines over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES stays below -30 while RESIDENTIAL rises above +8
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decrease over 28 days when WORKPLACES remains below -30 and RESIDENTIAL exceeds +8.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both keep weakening, it reflects stricter access or lower downtown activity, which reduces retail-recreation visits within one week.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both fall week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 days after both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES post two consecutive week-on-week decreases.
